summary: Etherpad plugin exposes unauthenticated host-info endpoint
details: The Etherpad plugin registers an HTTP GET route '/Nx_34308/' via the expressPreSession hook, which runs before Etherpad's authentication middleware. The handler responds to any unauthenticated remote caller with the server's hostname, OS username, platform, Node.js version, current working directory, and process id, and the response body is branded 'Nxploited | Nx-zD'. The package is published as 'ep_nxs34308' and described generically as 'Etherpad info'; the undocumented pre-auth reconnaissance endpoint and attacker-style branding do not match any legitimate plugin feature. Any Etherpad instance that installs and loads this plugin discloses host-identifying information useful for target fingerprinting and follow-on attacks to arbitrary unauthenticated network callers.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
